get.description: Selects at most two metro stations, two schools plus two kindergartens, and two clinics for one confirmed opaque map point. A bounded candidate pool is ranked by actual pedestrian-route length when routed; an unrouted nearby candidate remains explicitly unknown. One verified OMS clinic may replace the second local clinic and may be far away; selection_policy makes that exception explicit. Walking minutes are rounded up, ferries are excluded, and endpoints have a 50 m snap gate. Unknown entrances, live closures, service eligibility, and citywide POI completeness are not claimed. Responses are private, revalidated with weak ETag, and contain no raw source identities.

200.description: Bounded POI selection and individually gated walking routes

get.description: Returns at most 150 source-mapped POI markers for a bounded viewport. It does not calculate walking routes; layers are opt-in and hidden by default in the client. Polygon representative points are approximate locations, not verified entrances. Responses are private with weak ETag revalidation.

get.description: Coverage of one validated offline model-assessment run across every input source record. A source candidate is not necessarily a unique Moscow building or a confirmed project link. No validated run returns 503, never zero coverage.

Paginated evaluations of all source records, including unlinked OSM construction outlines and rejected non-Moscow or non-building events. A ready mapped outline is not an approved project or facade. No geometry URL or GLB appears in the list.

get.description: One evaluation with bounded public evidence. The registry link is nullable and never inferred from spatial proximity alone.

Provider-hidden dataset coverage; demo, real-current, geospatial and historical building registry counts remain separate. No QA or user conversion metrics.
